cycleArithmetic: Kill length is NOT on the wiki. Assumed kill = 16 pre-enrage volleys + 3 specials (wiki: queued at 80%/55%/30% = 720/495/270 HP) + 3 bind projectiles (wiki: 'After each special attack, the Whisperer will usually launch a binding projectile') + 1 landed double melee (standard play assumed to freeze/unbind 2 of the 3 binds) + 6 enrage attacks (140 HP at her 2-tick cadence while the player hits every 4-5 ticks) = 29 cycles. The 3 bind-projectile cycles (3/29 = 0.103) carry no damage and are left unassigned, so the shares below sum to 0.894.

attacks.name: ranged volley
attacks.uncertainReason: share and leak rest on the assumed 29-cycle kill and on assumed flick success; the wiki gives neither kill length nor hit rates
attacks.note: wiki (main): 'The Whisperer's regular attack involves shooting three projectiles per attack in either Ranged or Magic.' 'Protection prayers will fully block the attacks, and they will deal damage upon impact.' Strategies: 'Protection prayers fully block the projectiles' damage if activated before the projectile hits the player'; 'if not blocked, they can deal up to 40 and 36 damage respectively.' Infobox 'max hit1 = ... 40 (Ranged)'. Share: 16 pre-enrage volleys of 29 cycles, styles assumed 50/50 -> 8/29 = 0.276 ranged-equivalent volleys (the mixed 'M-M-R or R-R-M' and 'M-R-M or R-M-R' volleys are folded in by expectation: 1.5 ranged + 1.5 magic projectiles per volley on average). Leak by HP band: 900-720 single-style volleys (leak ~0), 720-270 '2+1' volleys (odd projectile lands in ~1 of 4 volleys -> 0.25/3 = 0.08 per projectile), 270-0 alternating volleys (two swaps, ~0.15 per projectile) -> (3x0 + 8x0.08 + 5x0.15)/16 = 0.09, rounded to 0.1.

attacks.name: magic volley
attacks.uncertainReason: same assumptions as the ranged volley (29-cycle kill, assumed flick success)
attacks.note: wiki Strategies: 'if not blocked, they can deal up to 40 and 36 damage respectively' (36 = magic, 'blue orbs'); infobox 'max hit1 = ... 36 (Magic)'. Share 8/29 = 0.276 (the other half of the 16 pre-enrage volleys). Mixing per wiki: 'After one or two special attacks have been used, she will use M-M-R or R-R-M'; after three specials 'M-R-M or R-M-R'. Flick advice quoted: 'When the second auto-attack of the same style (ranged or magic) is just about to hit the player, click to move and then switch prayers.' Leak 0.1 as for ranged.

attacks.name: melee (x2)
attacks.uncertainReason: prayerFactor 0.72 is derived from the Awakened figures (37-52 prayed vs 50-72 unprayed); Normal mode only says 'partially reduced by prayer'. Share assumes 1 of 3 binds ends in a landed double hit; no-freeze play would be 3/29 = 0.103
attacks.note: infobox 'max hit1 = 42 (x2) ([[Melee]])'. Main: 'If the player is standing next to or under her, she will utilise a melee attack that hits twice, with the second hit dealing the same as the first and is only partially reduced by prayer.' Strategies: 'The Whisperer will melee the player if they stand next to her, dealing two heavy hits in two ticks.' 'This melee attack hits through prayer, always hits and has the second hit mirror the first'. Trigger: 'After each special attack, the Whisperer will usually launch a binding projectile at the player that lasts for ~8 seconds. She will then move towards the player in an attempt to melee them.' Also 'she will immediately cancel it for a melee attack, which is extremely dangerous' if you run into melee range mid-volley. Avoidance per wiki: 'any ice spell or standard spellbook binding spell will successfully freeze her'; 'if the player stands at least 10 tiles away from where she launches the projectile, they will unbind'; 'Players should stay at least five tiles away from the Whisperer to avoid misclicks'; 'She cancels melee if she falls below 100 health after the third special.' Share: 3 binds per kill, 1 assumed to land -> 1/29 = 0.034. 'always hits' -> accuracy is not a factor. Leak 0.1 = the odd time Protect from Melee is not up when she closes; the perfect-kill list counts only 'unprotected melee' as avoidable damage, i.e. the game treats prayed melee as taken.

attacks.name: enrage ranged volley
attacks.uncertainReason: projectile count is not restated for the enrage (3 assumed); 6 enrage attacks per kill assumed; prayer blocking not restated for the enrage
attacks.note: Strategies: 'Upon reaching 0 health, the Whisperer will heal 140 hitpoints, restore any drained stats, and pull the player into the Shadow Realm.' 'She will alternate between ranged and magic every two attacks and increase her attack speed to 2 ticks (1.2 seconds).' Main: 'She will always start the phase off with a ranged attack, sending out two attacks and then switching to magic.' Prayer: the regular-attack rule ('Protection prayers fully block the projectiles' damage if activated before the projectile hits') is assumed to hold. Share: 140 HP assumed to take ~6 of her 2-tick attacks -> 3 ranged + 3 magic of 29 cycles = 0.103 each. Leak 0.1: the order is fixed (R R M M ...) so swaps are predictable, but at 2 ticks a late swap eats a projectile now and then.

Strategies: '(only one tentacle can hit the player at a time)'; 'Both formations can be dodged by performing an L movement'; 'even running directly into a tentacle usually won't cause damage as long as the player is moving.' After the 2nd special: 'she will begin utilising a + tentacle pattern alongside the X pattern.' Enrage: 'A single tentacle is launched alongside every attack, rather than a cluster of four.' phases: Specials: 'She will queue up a special attack upon reaching 80%, 55% and 30% of her health on the next attack she makes' (720/495/270 HP); each is followed by a ~8 s bind and a melee attempt. Volley mix by HP: 900-720 all three projectiles one style; 'after the first special attack, she will start attacking with two projectiles of one style and one of the other' (M-M-R / R-R-M); 'After the second special attack, she will begin utilising a + tentacle pattern alongside the X pattern'; 'after the third special attack, she will alternate between both combat styles' (M-R-M / R-M-R). 'She cancels melee if she falls below 100 health after the third special.' At 0 HP: heals 140, restores drained stats, pulls you into the Shadow Realm, 2-tick attacks, styles flip every two attacks starting with ranged, one tentacle per attack. Attack speed otherwise 10 ticks (infobox 'attack speed = 10', one value for all versions).
sanityOrOther: Sanity starts at 100%. 'When outside the Shadow Realm, the player will slowly restore 1% sanity every 4 ticks; inside, the player will lose 3% sanity along with 3 prayer points' (per tick). Tentacle hit -20% sanity; Screech -45%; Corrupted Seeds timeout -75%; 'Reaching 0%: you go insane and die within 10 ticks.' Soul Siphon's souls drain prayer. Specials are answered inside the Shadow Realm (sanity + prayer drain while there). 100% poison/venom resistance, cannon-immune, 60% Earth elemental weakness (June 2025). Perfect kill (50% more standard-table loot) = no 'ranged/magic hits, unprotected melee, tentacles, Screech, Soul Siphon, and stepping on or hatching corrupted seeds'.
